title: Settings — Discussion
description: Standalone Discussion-settings panel: the full standard Discussion option set (comment rules, moderation, notifications, threading/paging, avatars) over the REST settings surface.

documentation.purpose: DataForm over the full standard Discussion Settings option set: comment rules (`default_pingback_flag`, `default_ping_status`, `default_comment_status`, `require_name_email`, `comment_registration`, `close_comments_for_old_posts` + `close_comments_days_old`, `show_comments_cookies_opt_in`), threading (`thread_comments` + `thread_comments_depth`), pagination (`page_comments` + `comments_per_page` / `default_comments_page` / `comment_order`), notifications (`comments_notify`, `moderation_notify`), moderation (`comment_moderation`, `comment_previously_approved`, `comment_max_links`, `moderation_keys`, `disallowed_keys`), and avatars (`show_avatars` + `avatar_rating` / `avatar_default`). Core only REST-registers the two status fields; the plugin's `register_setting('discussion', …, { show_in_rest })` shims expose the rest so the whole panel saves in one PUT. Reads + writes through `core-data` `useEntityRecord('root','site')` via the shared `EntityDataForm`. Composable host (`core:settings`) mounts this for the `discussion` panel; shells mount it directly as a Discussion screen.

interactions.trigger: Toggle allow comments on new posts
Toggle Automatically close comments / Enable threaded comments / Break into pages / Show Avatars
interactions.effect: `edit({ <parent>: bool })`; reveals/hides its nested fields via `isVisible`.

interactions.trigger: Edit a numeric field (days old / depth / per-page / max links)
interactions.effect: `edit({ … })`; the value is clamped to the field's integer floor server-side by the `sanitize_callback` (clamp-only model — no schema `minimum`, since the REST controller validates the schema before sanitize, so a sub-floor write is clamped up rather than rejected).

interactions.trigger: Choose an enum (thread depth / pagination order / avatar rating / default avatar)
interactions.effect: `edit({ <option>: value })`; the server-side `enum` schema rejects out-of-range writes.
`await save()`; success snackbar / error notice via `useEntitySave`.

a11y.focus-management: Native DataForm focus order is sufficient.

constraints.note: `default_comment_status` / `default_ping_status` round-trip as `open`/`closed` strings; the boolean control maps both ways via getValue/setValue.
Thread depth select is hardcoded 2..10 (core's default `thread_comments_depth_max`); the live filter is honored server-side but not surfaced (no read endpoint for the filtered max).
`avatar_default` lists core's built-in set only; styles added via the `avatar_defaults` filter are not surfaced.

`wp_notes_notify` is intentionally neither rendered nor registered server-side — it is not a core option in WP 6.9 (Jetpack/WordPress.com), so a `show_in_rest` registration would be a write-to-nowhere phantom surface and a checkbox a no-op.
